title: Icon size is smaller than that of panel launchers at certain panel thicknesses
line: Quick Launch icons in a panel are now the same size as Icon widgets at every panel thickness.
explanation: In a panel, Quick Launch inset each launcher's icon by half a small spacing on every side, so the icon got the panel thickness minus 4 px. Kirigami.Icon rounds down to the next standard size, so at 22-30 px thick panels the launcher showed a 16 px icon while the Icon widget next to it showed 22 px. The change lets panel launchers fill the thickness (the popup list and the desktop keep their padding) and adds that padding to each cell along the panel instead, so launchers keep the same gap between them.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: fill the panel thickness with launcher icons

In panels each launcher icon was inset by a small padding on all sides,
so at some thicknesses it dropped to a smaller icon size than the Icon
widget next to it. Fill the thickness and space launchers lengthwise.

BUG: 461638

media.caption: Top panel at 22, 26, 30, 36 and 44 px: Quick Launch (left) next to an Icon widget for Dolphin; Quick Launch is smaller at 22-30 px
Same panel thicknesses with the fix: both icons are the same size at every thickness
Several launchers in a horizontal and a vertical panel: full-size icons with the same 4 px gap between them as before

review.text: Clean, minimal root-cause fix in `kdeplasma-addons` Quick Launch. Dropping `itemPadding` margins on `MouseArea` only for panel launchers lets `Kirigami.Icon` use the full panel thickness and match the Icon widget's icon-size rounding at all thicknesses, while adding `2 * itemPadding()` along the panel length in `layout.js` preserves spacing between adjacent launchers in both horizontal and vertical panels. Before/after screenshots clearly verify the fix across panel thicknesses and multi-launcher layouts.
